283048437.description:
This lot includes seven sealed VHS-C compact video cassette tapes for camcorders. It contains five Maxell TC-30 Premium High Grade HGX-Gold tapes, one JVC SX High Energy TC-20 SX tape, and one JVC EHG Hi-Fi TC-30 tape. The Maxell tapes come in gold and black boxes, while the JVC tapes have red/black and blue/gold packaging. All tapes measure approximately 3.75 x 2.25 inches. This item appears to be new and factory sealed in original shrink wrap.
A Note About Untested Cameras:
We want to be transparent about what we know and what we don't. Unless otherwise stated above, cameras have not been tested, and any included batteries, chargers, or accessories are also untested. Since all of our merchandise is donated, the condition of these components is unknown, and we cannot assume they are functional. Rather than speculate about a camera's operation, we prefer to describe it as untested and let the photos speak for its visible condition. Please review the listing carefully and bid accordingly.

282808092.description:
Geological Rock & Mineral Specimen Lot
Set of 4 Specimens
Sealed Plastic Display Cases
This collection features four distinct geological rock and mineral specimens, each preserved in an individual factory-sealed clear plastic display dome with black foam mounting. The assortment includes diverse geological formations, highlighted by a porous red volcanic scoria sample and a fibrous pale mineral specimen, ideal for earth science study or display.
Four unique raw geological specimens with varied textures and colors
Specimens mounted on black foam within clear plastic display domes
Factory-sealed protective blister cases designed for viewing and study
Condition:
All four specimens remain factory sealed within their original plastic display cases. The plastic packaging shows light exterior surface scuffs, scratches, and dust from storage, with the cases remaining structurally intact and fully sealed. Specimens inside are undisturbed and well preserved.
